model: Independent photographic reconstruction of a 16-inch MacBook Pro
implementation: Geometry created at runtime in app/model with Three.js primitives, extrusions and original Bezier paths. No imported model or Apple geometry.
materials: Procedural metal grain and speaker perforations; locally drawn key labels and original display artwork.
reference_use: Photographs supplied by the user were viewed as visual references only. They are not distributed or fetched by the viewer.
limitations: Photographic reconstruction, not certified CAD. Internal hardware, exact manufacturing profiles and M5-specific internal details are not represented.
trademarks: Apple and MacBook are trademarks of Apple Inc. This project is independent and unofficial.
